All six convert outputs have FailComponent, and MF Source columns have FailComponent on error and truncation. Because Sort is blocking, no row reaches Create before the failure. Constraint 8055 (Success) then blocks the archive move, 8059 is not satisfied, and 8058 is false because isFileExist=true, so Update employer amount does not run.

SUM(ISNULL(balance,0) * pct) skips NULL products while the denominator includes the balance. Accounts without employers get SUM = 0, so both values are 0, written when the stored values are NULL. (When every fund of an account has a NULL pct and the balance is not 0, the fee becomes NULL; see the UEA detailed verdict.)
